catalog.title: Website
catalog.summary: An open website brief: the model invents the subject, brand, content and visual direction of a complete site.
catalog.requirement: Original concept and identity; substantial real content; responsive layout; working interactions; accessible and fast

catalog.title: Restaurant Website
catalog.summary: A restaurant or cafe website with a full menu, reservations and a distinctive art direction.
catalog.requirement: Real menu with 30+ items; reservation and order flows with validation; opening-hours logic; strong identity; responsive and accessible

catalog.title: Browser Operating System
catalog.summary: A complete desktop operating system in the browser with its own identity, window management and a shared filesystem.
catalog.requirement: Window manager with snap and z-order; persisted shared filesystem; eight or more apps including a terminal and editor; launcher search; persistent settings

catalog.title: Data Story
catalog.summary: An interactive data-driven story built on a generated dataset, told through linked custom visualisations.
catalog.requirement: Four or more hand-built visual forms with linked interaction; a genuine insight with a narrative arc; annotations, tooltips and CSV export; responsive redraw

catalog.title: Generative Art
catalog.summary: A seeded generative artwork that evolves in real time and is worth watching rather than a screensaver.
catalog.requirement: Deterministic seeding from the URL; three or more scenes or developments; collaborative interaction; high-resolution PNG export; adaptive resolution

catalog.title: Creative Tool
catalog.summary: A professional-grade creative tool in the browser: layered, non-destructive, fast and dense enough for real work.
catalog.requirement: Real file open and export; layered non-destructive workflow with undo/redo; eight or more tools; autosave; smooth zoom and pan on large canvases

catalog.title: Production Site Refresh
catalog.summary: A fixed source: refresh the live Shutterhaus Visuals production site — same doctrine, a generation better, shipped as one self-contained static folder.
catalog.requirement: All five public pages rebuilt; keyboard gallery and scroll frames preserved; zero third-party requests; no build step; content in the markup; WCAG 2.2 AA; verified performance budget

runs.notes: Silent Press: a static, strictly monochrome editorial site with a seeded SVG poster generator, six selectable editions, live proofing, SVG download and shareable settings links. All artwork is drawn in code; there are no external assets or dependencies. Model identity was confirmed by the operator as Hy4 Flash. Requires JavaScript for the generator and interactive controls; the written content remains readable without it.

A standalone, strictly monochrome editorial website about the tones between black and white, with a pointer-reactive Canvas field, a luminance-matching instrument, six procedurally drawn plates, a selectable grey register, inverted theme, print styles and reduced-motion support. Model identity was confirmed by the operator as Hy4. No external assets, fonts, libraries or network calls; all imagery is SVG or Canvas. Known limitation: the interactive instruments require JavaScript, although the editorial text and initial captions remain in the HTML.

Komorebi, a Japanese-Danish open-fire restaurant in Copenhagen. Single-file site with full 33-item menu, instant search and dietary/category filters, reservation flow with calendar and slot logic, takeaway basket with localStorage persistence and checkout, real-time open/closed status from opening hours, mobile navigation, Web Audio ambient toggle, canvas hero/story/gallery illustrations, and a hidden chef's dish easter egg. No external assets beyond Google Fonts.

Aether OS: a single-file browser desktop with invented visual language, procedural wallpapers, synthesized sound, a real window manager, persisted virtual filesystem, and 10 apps (Files, Terminal, Editor, Paint, Music, Calendar, Browser, Monitor, Settings, Calculator). Includes lock screen, launcher with live search, notifications, alt-tab, context menus, and keyboard shortcuts. Terminal supports pipes, redirection, history, and tab completion.

LUMEN: a first-person descent into a bioluminescent cave system. Collect 8 crystals, avoid 8 patrolling Shades, stun them with a resonance pulse. Features pointer-lock FPS controls with AABB collision, sprint/stamina, health pickups, positional Web Audio, bloom post-processing, adaptive quality, gamepad and touch support, settings persistence, and win/lose/restart loop. Known limitations: requires network for Three.js CDN; touch controls are basic; no save of in-progress run beyond best time.

Interactive four-stroke spark-ignition engine cutaway with thermodynamic cycle, crank-slider kinematics, cam-driven valves, spark ignition, particle flow, live pressure/torque/valve-lift graphs, what-if failures and parameters, exploded view, sound and hidden oil-jet detail. Single-file canvas app; reduced-motion and touch/keyboard supported. Thermodynamics uses a simplified filling-and-emptying model; values are physically plausible but not CFD-grade.

Aether Drift: neon twin-stick survival with seeded runs, daily seed, run modifiers, power-ups, combos/graze, waves and bosses, meta upgrades, local leaderboard, ghost replay of best run, touch and gamepad support. Known limitations: generative music requires user gesture to start audio; ghost replay stored only for best run.
